overall_assessment: Changes required within the approved architecture. The operation-bound adapters, common outbound owner, scoped credentials, single MessageAcceptance writer, deterministic selection and preserved consumer contracts remain consistent with D01..10. The original Meta and Evolution counterexamples are corrected. A remaining contradictory-response case and weaknesses in the new D03/D10 protection evidence require remediation. No material performance or elegance regression is apparent from source. This review performed no execution; final all, PCV, dedicated audits, final review and post-activation operator proof remain pending.
recommended_path: Correct the remaining Meta contradiction handling and strengthen the pre-dispatch and stale-response regression probes within existing approved paths. Preserve the current architecture and recorded compatibility limits. Obtain candidate-bound canonical validation and complete the separately required delivery gates before closeout.

findings.title: Meta still accepts an envelope containing an explicit contradictory success flag
findings.rationale: In meta.client.ts:225, HTTP 200 with {success:false,messages:[{id:'external-ack'}]} returns ACCEPTED because the positive branch checks only error absence and the message ID. Likewise, {success:false,messages:[{}]} reaches ACK_WITHOUT_ID at lines238-241. The success field is examined only when considering rejection. These contradictory envelopes therefore permit authoritative Message persistence or an acknowledgement diagnostic despite D04 requiring a valid acknowledgement and uncertainty for contradictory responses. This is a new counterexample at the changed classifier locus, distinct from the resolved non-first and malformed-ID cases.
findings.suggested_action: Validate explicit success indicators before either positive acknowledgement branch. Contradictory or malformed indicators should produce UNKNOWN/TRANSPORT_UNCONFIRMED. Add raw HTTP regressions for both contradictory envelopes, preserving valid responses without a success field, stable refusals, one POST and the absence of local acceptance or diagnostic writes for unconfirmed transport.

findings.title: The stale-response assertions can finish before the Inbox consumes the response
findings.rationale: The corrected browser scenario establishes reachable, uniquely opened B and A threads and enters a fresh same-text draft. However, channel-transport.spec.ts:91-96 waits only for Playwright's response event before asserting a value and alert count that already hold before release. That event does not establish completion of api.ts response-body consumption or the Inbox responder continuation. Both assertions can therefore pass before a defective stale continuation clears the draft or changes the error state, leaving the required D10 protection susceptible to a false green.
findings.suggested_action: Synchronize with complete response consumption and browser-side handling before evaluating the retained draft and error state. Demonstrate that the scenario fails when the stale-completion generation fence is removed, then run the exact final browser/all candidate.

findings.title: The new pre-dispatch probe substitutes the adapter that must enforce the fence
findings.rationale: channel-transport.e2e-spec.ts:115-151 exercises the real resolver predicate, but replaces the shipping adapter with FencedDispatchChannel. That test-only channel itself invokes stillCurrent and blocks its synthetic effect. The probe remains green if BoundMetaChannel or BoundEvolutionChannel stops invoking its pre-dispatch callback. It establishes the resolver predicate's behavior without protecting the required D03 connection between that predicate and the actual provider dispatch. The shipping source currently contains the guard; this is a protection-harness gap, not a demonstrated vulnerability.
findings.suggested_action: Exercise the shipping bound adapters in negative pre-dispatch probes. A test factory can delegate to the real factory while wrapping its callback to mutate the disposable binding after resolution. Assert CHANNEL_CONTEXT_CHANGED, zero provider calls and zero OUT writes, and ensure removing the shipping callback invocation makes the probe fail.
